name: Sabarmati Ashram
description: Mahatma Gandhi's historic headquarters on the banks of the Sabarmati River, preserving his living quarters and independence movement archives.

name: Adalaj Stepwell
description: Intricately carved 15th-century five-story Solanki-style stepwell with subterranean pavilions and ornate pillars.

name: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque
description: Famed 16th-century mosque renowned worldwide for its delicately carved marble latticework jali depicting the Tree of Life.

name: Calico Museum of Textiles
description: Premier textile museum housing an exquisite collection of historic Indian fabrics, court textiles, and ceremonial tapestries.

name: Akshardham Temple Gandhinagar
description: Grand pink sandstone spiritual complex with manicured thematic gardens, cultural exhibition halls, and musical water shows.

name: Kankaria Lake
description: Vibrant lakefront promenade featuring the historic Nagina Wadi island palace, toy train, tethered hot-air balloon, and evening illumination.

name: Science City
description: Sprawling educational center offering an aquatic gallery with shark tunnels, robotics park, planetarium, and interactive physics pavilions.

name: Modhera Sun Temple
description: Ancient 11th-century Solanki architectural marvel dedicated to the Sun God Surya, situated beside the step-terraced Surya Kund water tank.

name: Rani Ki Vav
description: UNESCO World Heritage stepwell built as an inverted temple with seven subterranean levels adorned with over 500 principal sculptures.
